[Hacker News] The compile-time choice makes sense for a gateway: plugins sit in the hot path and often need database or queue access, which is awkward to expose through a WASM sandbox. The cost is the workflow verdverm points out: there is no prebuilt image to just pull and run. Do you plan to publish an official build with the default plugin set, for people who don't need custom plugins?

[Hacker News] We had a Docker image, but pulled it before launch because some APIs might still change. You have to build the Docker images, but we have GitHub releases for binaries.
